children.value: > Fact From Story | Ferro told Clark that Flexport's board met the day after Clark resigned and voted to fire him for cause.

> > Fact From Story | Ferro allegedly told Clark that Flexport would be willing to give him a block of 2 million shares — worth millions of dollars — if he signed a separation agreement that included nondisclosure and nondisparagement clauses.
> > > Fact From Story | Ferro told Clark that Flexport's resignation a week prior had not been accepted.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | People who are fired for cause are not usually offered large sums of money and shares in exchange for signing a separation agreement.
> > Fact From Story | Ferro told Clark that Flexport's resignation a week prior had not been accepted.
> > > Fact From Story | Ferro told him that his resignation a week prior had not been accepted, according to a person familiar with the conversation. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story | On Sept. 13, Flexport's chief legal counsel, Chris Ferro, contacted Clark. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | A company's legal counsel is authorized to communicate important decisions to employees. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge | People who are fired for cause are not usually offered large sums of money and shares in exchange for signing a separation agreement.
> Fact From Story | Flexport's chief legal counsel, Chris Ferro, contacted Clark and told him that his resignation a week prior had not been accepted.
> > Fact From Story | On Sept. 13, Flexport's chief legal counsel, Chris Ferro, contacted Clark. | Fact From Story
> > Commonsense Knowledge | A company's legal counsel is authorized to communicate important decisions to employees. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge | If a resignation is not accepted and an employee is fired for cause, they are considered to have been fired.
